description: Routine minor-piece development moves in the opening. Currently SILENT (variant 'default' is empty) — Mohit 2026-05-20: 'Develops the X to Y' was vapid narration of board events the user already sees. Honest silence > restating the move. The trigger conditions exclude tactical content (cp_loss < 30, no captures/checks/threats — those fire higher-priority rules first), so when R11 would have fired there's by definition NOTHING new to teach. If a future author wants to surface SOMETHING here (e.g. an opening principle reminder), edit variants.default below.

fact_glossary.moving_piece_type: Type of the piece that just moved
fact_glossary.phase: Game phase — needs to be 'opening' for this rule
fact_glossary.mover_is_user: true if the user just moved
